items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: He was a good trombone player. Very good musician. Fine man, band man.

ctx.x: Yeah. Was he really very good? Good.
Was he good? He was a good trombone player. Very good musician. Fine man, band man.
Do you know about when he died? How long he's been gone?
